fields.label: API style
fields.help: Leave empty to guess from the base URL. openai = chat/completions (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio…); anthropic = Claude's messages API.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Stored only on the tablet. Not needed for a local server (Ollama, LM Studio).

fields.label: Model
fields.help: Must be vision-capable: it reads your handwriting as an image.

fields.label: Reasoning effort
fields.help: openai api, thinking models only (o-series, Gemini 3.x). Leave empty otherwise.

fields.label: Max tokens
fields.help: Runaway guard. Thinking models count hidden reasoning tokens against it, so keep it roomy.

fields.label: Extra headers
fields.help: Optional. For OpenRouter's app headers, an Azure api-key, or a proxy token.

fields.label: The notebook remembers
fields.help: When on (default), the notebook keeps your pages on the tablet, he follows the conversation, and 「给我看看……」 / "show me…" conjures past pages. "off" disables all of it.

fields.label: Minutes that end a sitting
fields.help: After this long without writing, the next page begins a new sitting: the same afternoon for him, begun anew.

fields.label: Timezone offset
fields.help: Hours from UTC (the tablet keeps UTC). Dates of conjured memories read right, and he only knows your time of day when this is set.
